generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
The Authority reserves the right to accept or reject any or all tenders without giving any reasons.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Bidders should abide by other terms and conditions as per condition document attached.
In technical bid bidders will be upload all documents as per attached conditions document

technicalCriterionList.description: For previous work experience, the tenderer should produce satisfactory certificate obtained by an officer not less than DCF regarding completion of similar works of any two years in last five financial years. Satisfactory Certificate corresponding to the work order (issued by officer not less than rank of DCF).

Availability of credit facilities of not less than 30% of the amount of contract in the form of bank certificates / letter of credit with work indent number in the favour of tender accepting authority (DCF & TA) by any nationalized bank having jurisdiction of Mysuru working plan circle. Bank Certificate/Letter of Credit duly signed by competent authority

As this work is of technical in nature, tenderer should have the knowledge and work experience of total station survey, chain & compass survey, GPS survey, map reading, GIS & its applications etc. The tenderer have team should have the knowledge of map reading (Village map), describing the notified forests boundary, GPS co-ordinates collection and geo-referencing and should be a qualified surveyor having a certificate of Bachelors degree in civil engineering /Diploma in civil engineering from an university established by the law in India
